items.source: Active vs Completed: active_count shows in-flight calls; the _seconds series reflect only completed calls.
items.translation: 活跃与已完成：active_count 显示正在进行的调用；而 _seconds 系列仅反映已完成的调用。

items.source: Spring AI builds upon the observability features in the Spring ecosystem to provide insights into AI-related operations. It provides metrics and tracing capabilities for its core components: ChatClient (including Advisor), ChatModel, EmbeddingModel, ImageModel, and VectorStore.
items.translation: Spring AI 基于 Spring 生态系统中的可观测性功能，为 AI 相关操作提供洞察。它为以下核心组件提供了指标和追踪能力：ChatClient（包括Advisor）、ChatModel、EmbeddingModel、ImageModel以及VectorStore。

items.source: Timers → <base>_seconds_count, <base>_seconds_sum, <base>_seconds_max, and (when supported) <base>_active_count
items.translation: 计时器 → <base>_seconds_count、<base>_seconds_sum、<base>_seconds_max，以及（如受支持）<base>_active_count

items.source: For synchronous calls, the okhttp.requests span is correctly nested under the gen_ai.client.operation span. For streaming calls, the HTTP span is recorded but is not parented under the chat-model span — the SDK’s async streaming path hops onto ForkJoinPool.commonPool() before invoking Spring AI’s HTTP client, dropping the calling thread’s observation context at that boundary.
items.translation:
对于同步调用，`okhttp.requests` 跨度正确嵌套在 `gen_ai.client.operation` 跨度之下。  
对于流式调用，HTTP 跨度会被记录，但不会作为 chat-model 跨度的子跨度——SDK 的异步流式路径会在调用 Spring AI 的 HTTP 客户端之前跳转到 `ForkJoinPool.commonPool()`，从而在该边界处丢失了调用线程的观察上下文。

items.source: The db.vector.client.operation observations are recorded when interacting with the Vector Store. They measure the time spent on the query, add and remove operations and propagate the related tracing information.
items.translation: `db.vector.client.operation` 观测值在交互向量存储时会被记录。它们测量了 `query`、`add` 和 `remove` 操作所花费的时间，并传播相关的追踪信息。

items.source: The spring.ai.chat.client observations are recorded when a ChatClient call() or stream() operations are invoked. They measure the time spent performing the invocation and propagate the related tracing information.
items.translation: 当调用 ChatClient 的 `call()` 或 `stream()` 操作时，会记录 `spring.ai.chat.client` 观测数据。这些观测数据用于衡量执行调用所花费的时间，并传播相关的追踪信息。

items.source: The gen_ai.client.operation observations are recorded when calling the ChatModel call or stream methods. They measure the time spent on method completion and propagate the related tracing information.
items.translation: gen_ai.client.operation 观测会在调用 ChatModel 的 call 或 stream 方法时记录。它们衡量方法完成所花费的时间，并传播相关的追踪信息。

items.source: The name of the operation or command being executed. One of add, delete, or query.
items.translation: 执行的操作或命令名称。为 `add`、delete 或 query 之一。

items.source: Operation type (add, delete, query)
items.translation: 操作类型（add、delete、query）

items.source: Vector DB/provider (redis, chroma, pgvector, …)
items.translation: 向量数据库/提供商（redis、chroma、pgvector 等）

items.source: Refer to the Spring Boot Metrics and Spring Boot Tracing documentation to enable metrics and tracing support in your application.
items.translation: 参考 Spring Boot 指标 和 Spring Boot 追踪 文档，以在您的应用程序中启用指标和追踪支持。

items.source: Both the OpenAI and Anthropic chat models do emit HTTP-layer observations (chat-model layer + HTTP layer), with one limitation specific to streaming calls. The HTTP-layer observation carries HTTP method, URI, status code, and propagates traceparent on the wire to downstream services (AI gateways, proxies, OpenAI-compatible inference servers).
items.translation: OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的聊天模型均会发出 HTTP 层观测数据（包含聊天模型层 + HTTP 层），但流式调用存在一项特定限制。HTTP 层观测数据包含 HTTP 方法、URI 和状态码，并通过网络将 traceparent 传播至下游服务（AI 网关、代理服务器、兼容 OpenAI 的推理服务器）。

items.source: See the OpenAI chat docs and Anthropic chat docs for details.
items.translation: 有关详细信息，请参阅OpenAI 聊天文档和Anthropic 聊天文档。

items.source: Log the prompt content. true or false
items.translation: 记录提示内容。true 或 false

items.source: Log the completion content. true or false
items.translation: 记录完成内容。true 或 false

items.source: Include error logging in observations. true or false
items.translation: 在观察中启用错误日志记录。true 或 false

items.source: Include the tool call content in observations. true or false
items.translation: 在观察中包括工具调用内容。true 或 false

items.source: Log the image prompt content. true or false
items.translation: 记录图像提示内容。true 或 false

items.source: Log the vector store query response content. true or false
items.translation: 记录向量存储查询响应内容。true 或 false

items.source: Active (*_active_count) — instantaneous gauge of in-progress operations (concurrency/load).
items.translation: 活跃（*_active_count）——正在执行操作的瞬时指标（并发/负载）。

items.source: Completed (*_seconds_sum|count|max) — statistics for operations that have finished:
items.translation: 已完成 (*_seconds_sum|count|max)——针对已完成的操作的统计信息：

items.source: Is the chat model response a stream - true or false
items.translation: 聊天模型响应是否为流式输出——true 或 false

items.source: The kind of framework API in Spring AI: chat_client.
items.translation: Spring AI 中的框架 API 类型为：chat_client。

items.source: The ChatClient prompt and completion data is typically big and possibly containing sensitive information. For those reasons, it is not exported by default.
items.translation:
`ChatClient` 的提示词和完成数据通常体积较大，且可能包含敏感信息。  
因此，这些数据默认不会被导出。

items.source: The spring.ai.advisor observations are recorded when an advisor is executed. They measure the time spent in the advisor (including the time spent on the inner advisors) and propagate the related tracing information.
items.translation: 当执行顾问时，会记录 `spring.ai.advisor` 观测数据。这些观测数据用于衡量在顾问中花费的时间（包括在内层顾问中花费的时间），并传播相关的追踪信息。

items.source: The kind of framework API in Spring AI: advisor.
items.translation: Spring AI 中的框架 API 类型：advisor。

items.source: Whether the request was made in streaming mode. Only present when true.
items.translation: 是否为流式模式发起的请求。仅在为 true 时显示。

items.source: The spring.ai.tool observations are recorded when performing tool calling in the context of a chat model interaction. They measure the time spent on tool call completion and propagate the related tracing information.
items.translation: 在聊天模型交互过程中执行工具调用时，会记录 `spring.ai.tool` 观测值。这些观测值用于衡量工具调用的耗时，并传播相关的追踪信息。

items.source: The name of the operation being performed. It’s always execute_tool.
items.translation: 操作名称。它始终为 `execute_tool`。

items.source: The provider responsible for the operation. It’s always spring_ai.
items.translation: 负责操作的提供者。它始终为 `spring_ai`。

items.source: The kind of operation performed by Spring AI. It’s always tool_call.
items.translation: Spring AI 执行的操作类型。它始终是 `<code>tool_call`》。

items.source: The type of the tool. By default, it’s function.
items.translation: 工具的类型。默认为 `<code>function`。

items.source: The gen_ai.client.operation observations are recorded on embedding model method calls. They measure the time spent on method completion and propagate the related tracing information.
items.translation: `gen_ai.client.operation` 观测记录在嵌入模型方法调用上。它们衡量方法完成所花费的时间，并传播相关的追踪信息。

items.source: The gen_ai.client.operation observations are recorded on image model method calls. They measure the time spent on method completion and propagate the related tracing information.
items.translation: `gen_ai.client.operation` 观测记录在图像模型方法调用上。它们衡量方法完成所花费的时间，并传播相关的追踪信息。

items.source: The size of the image to generate (e.g. 1024x1024).
items.translation: 生成图像的尺寸（例如 1024x1024）。

items.source: The kind of framework API in Spring AI: vector_store.
items.translation: Spring AI 中的框架 API 类型为：vector_store。

items.source: Spring AI uses Micrometer. Base metric names use dots (e.g., gen_ai.client.operation), which Prometheus exports with underscores and standard suffixes:
items.translation: Spring AI 使用 Micrometer。基础指标名称使用点号（例如 `gen_ai.client.operation`），而 Prometheus 将其导出时使用下划线和标准后缀：

items.source: OpenTelemetry — Semantic Conventions for Generative AI (overview)
items.translation: OpenTelemetry — 生成式 AI 的语义约定（概述）

items.source: Micrometer — Naming Meters
items.translation: 微秒计器——命名度量器

items.source: _seconds_sum / _seconds_count → average latency
items.translation: _seconds_sum / _seconds_count → 平均延迟

items.source: _seconds_max → high-water mark since last scrape (subject to registry behavior)
items.translation: _seconds_max → 自上次抓取以来的最高水位线（受注册表行为影响）

items.source: List of configured chat client advisors.
items.translation: 已配置的聊天客户端顾问列表。

items.source: Identifier of the conversation when using the chat memory.
items.translation: 使用聊天记忆时的会话标识符。

items.source: Names of the tools passed to the chat client.
items.translation: 传递给聊天客户端的工具名称。

items.source: Spring AI supports logging the prompt and completion data to help with debugging and troubleshooting.
items.translation: Spring AI 支持记录提示词和完成数据，以帮助调试和故障排除。

items.source: Whether to log the chat client prompt content.
items.translation: 是否记录聊天客户端的提示内容。

items.source: Whether to log the chat client completion content.
items.translation: 是否记录聊天客户端的完成内容。

items.source: Name of the advisor.
items.translation: 顾问姓名。

items.source: Advisor order in the advisor chain.
items.translation: 顾问链中的顾问指令。

items.source: The frequency penalty setting for the model request.
items.translation: 模型请求的频率惩罚设置。

items.source: The maximum number of tokens the model generates for a request.
items.translation: 模型为请求生成的最大 token 数量。

items.source: The presence penalty setting for the model request.
items.translation: 模型请求的存在惩罚设置。

items.source: List of sequences that the model will use to stop generating further tokens.
items.translation: 模型将用于停止生成更多 token 的序列列表。

items.source: The temperature setting for the model request.
items.translation: 模型请求的温度设置。

items.source: The top_k sampling setting for the model request.
items.translation: 模型请求中的 top_k 采样设置。

items.source: The top_p sampling setting for the model request.
items.translation: 模型请求中的 top_p 采样设置。

items.source: Reasons the model stopped generating tokens, corresponding to each generation received.
items.translation: 模型停止生成 token 的原因，对应于每次接收到的生成结果。

items.source: The unique identifier for the AI response.
items.translation: AI 响应的唯一标识符。

items.source: The number of input tokens written to a provider-managed cache.
items.translation: 写入由提供商管理的缓存的输入令牌数量。

items.source: The number of input tokens served from a provider-managed cache.
items.translation: 由提供商管理的缓存中提供的输入 token 数量。

items.source: The number of tokens used in the model input (prompt).
items.translation: 模型输入（提示词）中使用的 token 数量。

items.source: The number of tokens used in the model output (completion).
items.translation: 模型输出（补全）中使用的 token 数量。

items.source: List of tool definitions provided to the model in the request.
items.translation: 请求中提供给模型的工具体义列表。

items.source:
The chat prompt and completion data is typically big and possibly containing sensitive information.
For those reasons, it is not exported by default.
items.translation:
聊天提示词和完成数据通常体积庞大，且可能包含敏感信息。  
因此，这些数据默认不会导出。

items.source: Spring AI supports logging chat prompt and completion data, useful for troubleshooting scenarios. When tracing is available, the logs will include trace information for better correlation.
items.translation: Spring AI 支持记录聊天提示词和完成数据，适用于故障排查场景。当启用追踪时，日志将包含追踪信息，以便更好地进行关联分析。

items.source: The name of the tool.
items.translation: 工具名称。

items.source: Description of the tool.
items.translation: 工具描述。

items.source: Schema of the parameters used to call the tool.
items.translation: 调用工具时所使用的参数模式。

items.source: The ID of the tool call, as identified by the chat model.
items.translation: 由聊天模型识别的工具调用 ID。

items.source: The input arguments to the tool call. (Only when enabled)
items.translation: 工具调用的输入参数。（仅在启用时显示）

items.source: The result of the tool call execution. (Only when enabled)
items.translation: 工具调用执行的结果。（仅当启用时显示）

items.source: The input arguments and result from the tool call are not exported by default, as they can be potentially sensitive.
items.translation: 工具调用的输入参数和结果默认不会导出，因为它们可能包含敏感信息。

items.source: Spring AI supports exporting tool call arguments and result data as span attributes.
items.translation: Spring AI 支持将工具调用参数和结果数据导出为 Span 属性。

items.source: The number of dimensions the resulting output embeddings have.
items.translation: 结果输出嵌入的维度数量。

items.source: The number of tokens used in the model input.
items.translation: 模型输入中使用的 token 数量。

items.source: The format in which the generated image is returned.
items.translation: 生成图像的返回格式。

items.source: The style of the image to generate.
items.translation: 生成图像的风格。

items.source:
The image prompt data is typically big and possibly containing sensitive information.
For those reasons, it is not exported by default.
items.translation:
图像提示数据通常体积庞大，且可能包含敏感信息。  
因此，默认情况下不会导出该数据。

items.source: Spring AI supports logging image prompt data, useful for troubleshooting scenarios. When tracing is available, the logs will include trace information for better correlation.
items.translation: Spring AI 支持记录图像提示数据，适用于故障排查场景。当启用追踪时，日志将包含追踪信息，以便更好地进行关联分析。

items.source: All vector store implementations in Spring AI are instrumented to provide metrics and distributed tracing data through Micrometer.
items.translation: Spring AI 中的所有向量存储实现均已通过 Micrometer 进行配置，以提供指标和分布式追踪数据。

items.source: The name of a collection (table, container) within the database.
items.translation: 数据库中集合（表、容器）的名称。

items.source: The name of the database, fully qualified within the server address and port.
items.translation: 数据库名称，包含服务器地址和端口的完整限定名。

items.source: The metric used in similarity search.
items.translation: 相似度搜索中使用的度量标准。

items.source: The dimension of the vector.
items.translation: 向量的维度。

items.source: The name field as of the vector (e.g. a field name).
items.translation: 向量中的名称字段（例如字段名）。

items.source: The content of the search query being executed.
items.translation: 正在执行的搜索查询内容。

items.source: The metadata filters used in the search query.
items.translation: 搜索查询中使用的元数据过滤器。

items.source: Returned documents from a similarity search query. Optional.
items.translation: 相似搜索查询返回的文档。可选。

items.source: Similarity threshold that accepts all search scores. A threshold value of 0.0 means any similarity is accepted or disable the similarity threshold filtering. A threshold value of 1.0 means an exact match is required.
items.translation: 接受所有搜索分数的相似度阈值。阈值为 0.0 表示接受任何相似度或禁用相似度阈值过滤。阈值为 1.0 表示需要完全匹配。

items.source: The top-k most similar vectors returned by a query.
items.translation: 查询返回的相似度最高的前 k 个向量。

items.source:
The vector search response data is typically big and possibly containing sensitive information.
For those reasons, it is not exported by default.
items.translation:
向量搜索响应数据通常体积较大，且可能包含敏感信息。  
因此，默认情况下不会导出该数据。

items.source: Spring AI supports logging vector search response data, useful for troubleshooting scenarios. When tracing is available, the logs will include trace information for better correlation.
items.translation: Spring AI 支持记录向量搜索响应数据，适用于故障排查场景。当启用追踪时，日志将包含追踪信息，以便更好地进行关联分析。
